title: Keeping Equipment Rental and Demo Kit Beyond the Date Written on the Agreement
content:
## Where this applies

A guest who asks to keep hire kit of the Equipment Rental and Demo line longer than the agreement was written for is taking an extension, and this is the basis on which the charge for it is settled and the later date recorded.

An extension is recorded before the kit falls due, and kit already overdue is handled as a late hand-in instead. A season lease is not extended at all.

## When the charge is fixed

1. The charge for the extra days is fixed only after the hire rate for the days the agreement was written for stands on its rental account.

2. The charge for the extra days is fixed only after every change of model recorded on the agreement carries the shop's fee owed for it.

## What taking the extension does

One entry moves the date the kit is due back on the agreement out to the date given, widens the number of days the agreement covers by the days added, books a single extension entry on the agreement's rental account for the amount the guest is accepting, and raises the amount still to be collected on the agreement by that amount. Afterwards the guest sees the later due date on the agreement and the extension and its amount on the rental account.

## Taking the extension

The extension is taken with the hidden tool `confirm_rental_extension_b56bb368`, which is the guest's own: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves confirms keeping the kit longer. One call takes one extension.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `rental_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the rental agreement the guest is keeping longer, read from the rental agreement lookup before the call. |
| `new_due_date` | A fixed-format date: the date the kit is now due back, written as YYYY-MM-DD on the shop's local calendar, with no time of day and no empty-value convention. A date must always be given. |
| `extension_charge_usd` | A fixed-format amount: the amount the guest is accepting for keeping the kit longer, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the last step only. Where nothing is being charged, 0.00 is passed. |

None of the three takes a value from an enumerated set.

### What comes back

A plain-language confirmation naming the reference number minted for the new extension entry, the agreement it was booked against, the date the kit is now due back, the number of days added, the amount booked and the agreement's outstanding figure after the entry. Receiving that confirmation is what indicates the extension was taken; the later due date and the entry are then readable on the agreement and its rental account.
